content:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the changelog slate and the internal signal plan for tomorrow's rollout. Need a short eng blurb + an exec-friendly line, plus final rollback/cutover criteria. @ops-oncall @sam

sam: ok. eng blurb should call out what changes (batching + KV cache), and one line for impact to cost. exec line = 1 sentence.

maria: draft eng blurb: "Improved inference throughput: smarter batching + proactive KV-cache prefetch reduces token cost by ~15% and lowers typical latency. Fallback to a smaller model variant if latency exceeds SLO."

jordan: sounds good. can we include the pinned model version and how long we pin?

lee: suggest small wording tweak: change "KV-cache" -> "KV cache" and specify pin: model-v2.3 (48h). also add a note that dedicated customers might see routing differences.

maria: updated: eng blurb now includes "model pinned: model-v2.3 for 48h". exec blurb draft: "Performance & cost optimizations to inference; no customer action required — ops team will monitor."

ops-oncall: I'll own rollback and cutover. Proposed rollback triggers: error rate >2% (5m rolling) OR sustained p50 latency +100ms over baseline for 10m. Rollback plan: canary rollback to previous pinned model, then full rollback if canary indicates regression.

katie: sales/AE blurb (for internal note): "No customer action needed. For dedicated customers we’ll notify if we change routing or capacity."

maria: great. deploybot will run a canary first — can we include the deploybot cue in the internal note?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria at 1746015000. mode: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% (gradual). hooks: metrics-check at each step.

lee: add quick QA snippet so folks can run the latency smoke test: ```bash
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"latency test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

frank: infra will standby during canary window. tagging @ops-oncall for immediate slack page if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: canary metrics @ 1746015600: p50=95ms, error_rate=0.1%, tokens/sec +12%. no alarms.

ops-oncall: ok. I'll escalate if either trigger is crossed. Jordan — need your sign-off before scaling to 50%.

jordan: sign-off given. scale to 50% at +15m if no regressions.

maria: final internal note (will post to #eng-releases + ops):

--- INTERNAL NOTE START ---
Changelog (brief, for engineers):
- Smarter batching + KV cache prefetch reduces token cost by ~15% and improves typical latency.
- Model pinned: model-v2.3 for 48h to maintain stability during evaluation window.
- Fallback: automatic routing to smaller model variant if latency >200ms for sustained 10m.

Exec-friendly 1-line:
Performance and cost optimizations to inference pipeline; no customer action required.

Deploy cadence and signal (ops):
- Deploybot: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% (gradual).
- Rollback triggers: error_rate >2% (5m rolling) OR p50 latency increase >100ms sustained for 10m.
- Rollback path: canary rollback to previous pinned model, then full rollback if canary indicates regression.
- Owner: @ops-oncall, standby: @frank.

Customer-facing note for Sales: "No customer action required; we’ll contact dedicated customers if routing changes are needed."

Quick QA smoke test (for verification): see snippet above.

Posting plan: will publish at 10:45am to #eng-releases and ping @ops-oncall and @frank for watch.

--- INTERNAL NOTE END ---

maria: I'll push this in 20m unless anyone objects.

sam: lgtm. add a tiny CTA for devex: "Check SDKs for pinned model id and update example configs if needed."

lee: +1. also add a one-line addendum about metric dashboards to watch (p50, p95, errors).

maria: done. posting in 5m. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
